2 16-05-2024 This appeal is against the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 12.01.2024/
16.01.2024, passed in POCSO Case No. 161 of 2022, arising out of Sahkund (Sajour) P.S. Case No.
224 of 2022 by the learned Exclusive Special Court (POCSO Act)-cum-7th Additional District and Sessions Judge, Bhagalpur, whereby the appellant has been convicted for the offence under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 5(J)(II)/6 of the POCSO Act, 2012.
2. Admit.
Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.145 of 2024(2) dt.16-05-2024 3.
Call for the Trial Court Records.
4. Since a prayer for suspension of sentence has been made in the memo of appeal, the learned APP shall put in the written objection by the next date.
5. Re-notify this appeal on receipt of the Trial Court Records on 10th of July, 2024.
